checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same matte black bottle recognizable, shape preserved
must.why: Shape, cap, ring and base closely match; cap loop slightly redrawn but minor.

must.item: Bottle on light stone counter, not wood

must.why: Blue-grey cabinets, backsplash, window, canisters; softly blurred and tidy.

must.item: Clean edges and believable contact shadow
must.why: Edges clean; shadow falls to the right at the base, grounded.

faults.what: Cap loop/top opening slightly redrawn versus original (hole shape differs).
Low resolution 640px; counter surface slightly busy with pits.

summary: The bottle is nearly identical and sits convincingly on a light stone counter in a tidy blurred modern kitchen, with only a slightly altered cap loop.
